batch: Classify five older works from publisher and university evidence
policy: These are work-scope judgments only. They do not certify complete object extraction, endorse readings, resolve identities, or change text and media rights.

entries.basis: Bar-Ilan University's abstract for DOI 10.1163/147783511X619845 describes editions of IM 76106 and a new parallel bowl.
Cambridge's publisher extract and the complete SOAS institutional copy describe publication of IM 9726 and republication of the Pearson bowl.
Cambridge's publisher extract and article notes describe readings and translation for two incantation-bowl texts.
Gorgias Press's detailed contents list description, palaeography, text, translation and line-by-line discussion for one Syriac bowl.
Brill's chapter preview presents a comparative study of incantation-bowl imagery and Talmudic descriptions.
